Who We Are & Why Join Us Avathon is the leading Industrial AI autonomy platform, helping customers across heavy industries -- energy, mining, manufacturing, aerospace, defense, and logistics -- accelerate the journey toward autonomous operations. Our platform is built on a Computational Knowledge Graph foundation that contextualizes and connects operational data across siloed systems, bringing together time series, structured, unstructured, and machine vision data to power AI-driven applications in asset performance management, supply chain intelligence, visual AI, and global trade management. With capabilities spanning digital twins, normal behavior modeling, natural language processing, and computer vision, Avathon delivers real-time predictive intelligence and agentic decision-making at industrial scale. Cutting-Edge AI Innovation -- Join a team at the forefront of AI, developing groundbreaking solutions that shape the future. High-Growth Environment -- Thrive in a fast-scaling startup where agility, collaboration, and rapid professional growth are the norm. Meaningful Impact -- Work on AI-driven projects that drive real change across industries and improve lives. Learn more at: avathon.com Work Location: Bangalore Five Days onsite At Avathon, we are building cutting-edge AI solutions that transform operations across asset-intensive industries such as Supply Chain, Logistics, Energy, Mining, Aerospace, and Industrial Manufacturing. Avathon is an enterprise-grade native AI and data platform designed to unify multiple complex applications under a single pane of glass. We are moving beyond legacy monoliths into a highly scalable, decoupled Micro Front-End (MFE) architecture powered by a Central Knowledge Graph (CKG). As a Full Stack Engineer on the Platform team, you will be instrumental in building our core infrastructure and commercializing specialized domain apps. You will leverage modern AI coding tools to maintain high developer velocity, ensuring architectural consistency across the ecosystem. You Will Architecting the Platform: Building and scaling decoupled applications using our standard MFE architecture (Webpack 5 Module Federation) and Django/PostgreSQL microservices. Impact: This reduces DevOps overhead and ensures independent, scalable deployments. Driving High-Impact Integrations: Leading strategic initiatives, such as integrating the DMA Government application into the commercial Avathon Platform as a standardized MFE and Microservice. Impact: This standardizes our tech stack, eliminates redundant code, and accelerates our commercial go-to-market strategy. Building AI-Grounded Features: Developing features that interact seamlessly with our AI Model Garden APIs and Central Knowledge Graph (CKG). Maximizing Developer Velocity: Utilizing reusable platform patterns and heavily leveraging AI development tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude, etc.) to rapidly take products from prototype to production. Collaborating Globally: Working with cross-functional teams to extend our foundational backend data tier, including robust identity/access control and event-driven webhooks. You'll Have BS or MS in Computer Science or a related field, with a strong foundation in system design and data structures. 4+ years of experience building and deploying scalable full-stack applications. (Startup experience is a plus). Frontend Expertise: Deep experience with React 18, TypeScript, and modern state/form management tools like Redux Toolkit, React Router v7, and React Hook Form + Zod. Backend Expertise: Strong proficiency in Python, Django 5.x, and PostgreSQL, with experience designing both REST APIs and GraphQL endpoints. AI-Assisted Development: Proven experience utilizing AI tools (e.g., Copilot, Claude) to accelerate coding, debugging, and test generation. Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and agile software development tools. Preferred Qualifications Experience working with Micro Front-End (MFE) architectures or migrating monoliths to decoupled services. Experience with Graph databases or utilizing a Central Knowledge Graph for spatial/relational querying. Familiarity with Identity and Access Management (IAM) systems like Keycloak (OIDC/OAuth2) and implementing strict Role-Based Access Control (RBAC). Experience with modern CSS frameworks like Tailwind CSS. Experience building event-driven systems, asynchronous message queues, or webhook dispatchers. Interview Process As part of the interview process, you will be asked to complete a technical case study assessment. Expect atleast two-three rounds of Technical interviewing rounds and one onsite round. Avathon is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, pregnancy, genetic information, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected category under applicable federal, state, and local laws. Avathon is committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process. If you need a reasonable accommodation, please contact us to discuss how we can assist you. Direct message the job poster from Digiaccel Learning Aparna Upadhyay Aparna Upadhyay Assistant Manager, HR Software Engineer (SDE I) || Altera Institute - Digiaccel Learning At Digiaccel Learning and Altera Institute, we are on a mission to redefine management education for the digital and AI-first world. We are building technology that powers transformative learning experiences for thousands of learners across India. From learner journeys and assessments to AI enabled learning experiences and internal platforms, our engineering team plays a critical role in shaping the future of education. As a Software Development Engineer (SDE I), you will contribute to building intuitive, scalable and high-performance applications that enhance the learner experience across our ecosystem. You will work alongside experienced engineers, product managers, and designers to develop robust solutions while strengthening your technical expertise across the full technology stack. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving challenging problems, learning rapidly, taking ownership, and creating products that have a meaningful impact on the lives of learners. Key Responsibilities Full Stack Development & Feature Delivery • Design, develop, and maintain web applications using the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, and Node.js). • Build reusable components and modules that enhance application performance and maintainability. • Translate product requirements into scalable technical solutions. • Contribute to feature development while ensuring adherence to established engineering standards. Engineering Excellence & Code Quality • Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code by following coding standards and development best practices. • Participate actively in code reviews and implement feedback to improve overall software quality. • Collaborate with senior engineers to understand architecture decisions and strengthen engineering capabilities. • Continuously improve code quality, application performance, and system reliability. Collaboration & Cross-Functional Execution • Work closely with Product, Design, and Engineering teams to understand business requirements and implement new features. • Participate in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, testing cycles, and deployment activities. • Coordinate with team members to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality software solutions. • Actively contribute ideas and suggestions to improve existing processes and systems. Problem Solving & Performance Optimization • Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve technical issues across different components of the application stack. • Identify performance bottlenecks and contribute towards optimizing application responsiveness and scalability. • Monitor application performance and proactively resolve technical concerns. Quality Assurance & Continuous Learning • Develop and execute unit and integration tests to ensure application quality and reliability. • Maintain accurate and comprehensive technical documentation. • Stay updated with emerging technologies, frameworks, and industry trends to continuously enhance technical skills. What We're Looking For • A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. • 1-3 years of experience in full-stack software development using the MERN stack. • Strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+), React.js, Node.js, MongoDB, Nest.js and Express.js. • A solid understanding of front-end technologies, including HTML5 and CSS3. • Familiarity with RESTful APIs and third-party integrations. • Experience with version control systems such as Git. • Exposure to Next.js and NestJS will be considered an advantage. • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with a keen eye for detail. • Excellent collaboration skills and learning mindset combined with a strong sense of ownership and accountability. Why Join Us? • Build Technology That Creates Impact - Develop products that influence the learning experiences and careers of thousands of professionals. • Accelerated Learning Environment - Work alongside experienced leaders and engineers in a highly collaborative environment. • High Ownership Culture - Take responsibility for meaningful work from the very beginning of your journey. • Continuous Growth Opportunities - Gain exposure to modern technologies, scalable systems, and rapidly evolving product ecosystems. • Collaborative Team Culture - Become part of a team that values curiosity, innovation, transparency, and continuous improvement. About the Company Digiaccel Learning is a Gurgaon headquartered education company that is redefining the gold standard of management education for the digital and AI first world. By doing so, it is building the next generation of business leaders in the country. The mission of the company is to build employability through education. Education is a hard and important problem to solve for. India needs to double its higher education infrastructure in order to serve its large demographic of youth. Within what exists, quality is a large problem with studies reporting that 50% of Indian graduates are unemployable. Add to this the shift in the skills ecosystem at the workplace with AI and digitization. All of this has led to a higher-education infrastructure that is unable to serve the aspirations of its students. So, you have MBA students from legacy institutes who are unplaced and professionals who are struggling to level up in their careers because they don’t have the skills to progress. The secret sauce at the company is its instructional design, a learner centric ethos and a bar for quality that runs across touchpoints. This reflects in a 80%+ NPS across all programs since inception. Digiaccel Learning is VC backed and has CXOs and Founders of some of India’s top digital commerce companies as it’s investors. We are looking for smart passionate folks to join us in this mission of building a better, smarter and more outcome oriented education system. We are a young company and each role has the ability to make a large impact. We can assure of a very talent dense, intellectually honest, action oriented and collaborative environment. We are sure that you will join for the opportunity and stay for the impact of seeing your work help thousands of others. In this role, you will assist in developing, testing, maintaining, and enhancing software applications across our technology stack. You will work closely with senior developers, technical leads, and product managers to write clean code, troubleshoot issues, and contribute to production-grade software solutions throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC). Software Development & Coding - Write clean, maintainable, efficient, and well-documented code under the supervision of senior engineers. - Assist in developing front-end interfaces, back-end APIs, or database scripts based on product requirements. - Work with modern frameworks, libraries, and tools used within the company's tech stack. - Participating in code reviews to receive constructive feedback and continuously improve coding standards. 2. Preferred - Prior internship experience, open-source contributions, or personal project portfolio in software development. - Familiarity with RESTful APIs, Cloud basics (AWS/GCP/Azure), or Docker containers. - Degree (completed or pursuing) in B.Tech/B.E./MCA/BCA in Computer Science or Information Technology. Your Role And Responsibilities As an Application Developer: AWS Cloud FullStack, you will design and develop scalable, resilient, and cloud-native applications using modern technologies and methodologies. You will work in an Agile environment, delivering high-quality solutions through continuous release and improvement cycles. Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include Develop Rich UI Applications: Design and develop rich user interface applications using Single Page Applications (SPA) or microfrontends, utilizing frameworks such as ReactJS or Angular. Event-Driven Architecture: Experience with developing event-driven applications using messaging and streaming services, such as Kafka, SQS, SNS, and Kinesis Streams. Familiarity with GraalVM: Exposure to GraalVM runtime for developing scalable and resilient backend microservices. Description Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) powers the physical engine at the heart of Amazon — magically turning your click of a button into packages at your door. Within AFT, the Labor Insights team builds and operates the platform that tracks on associate labor performance across Amazon's entire global warehouse network. Labor Insights' suite of 18+ services supports ~1 million associates and 70,000+ daily portal users across 9,800+ facilities and 10 business lines — ingesting over 19 billion labor events annually to produce the real-time productivity reports that warehouse managers rely on to run their operations every day. We leverage AWS technologies, stream processing, and AI/ML to build distributed, highly available systems that operate at massive scale. Are you ready for a challenge? As a Software Development Engineer on the Labor Insights team, you will build the next generation of Amazon's labor management platform — designing systems that ingest billions of labor events from warehouse floor tools and time clock systems, aggregate them through multi-stage pipelines, and serve real-time productivity reports to operations managers across the globe. You will own design and development of distributed systems that refresh reports every 10–15 minutes across 3 global regions while maintaining 99.9% availability. You will contribute to a wide range of projects — from event processing pipelines and aggregation engines to reporting APIs, modern React-based portals, and AI-powered configuration tools. Most excitingly, you will help drive refresh of the existing tool, an AI-first greenfield initiative to rebuild the platform from the ground up using modern stream-based architecture, eliminating a decade of technical debt and delivering near real-time metrics. You will be involved in all aspects of the software development cycle including scoping, design, implementation, testing, and delivery. A commitment to teamwork, hustle, and strong communication skills are absolute requirements. Creating reliable, scalable, and high-performance services requires exceptional technical expertise. If you have that expertise, are customer-centric, and motivated about building systems that operate at global scale, then we want to talk to you! Key job responsibilities Design, develop, and test software components across Labor Insights' ingestion, aggregation, reporting, and configuration layers — handling labor events, time clock punches, employee location tracking, and productivity report generation Build new services using AI-assisted development practices, leveraging tools like Amazon Q and Bedrock to achieve high-velocity delivery on greenfield systems Design large-scale data processing solutions using DynamoDB, PostgreSQL, S3, SQS/SNS, EventBridge, Lambda, and stream processing frameworks (Cosmos/Flink) optimized for high throughput and low-latency access Drive service consolidation and modernization — migrating from legacy infrastructure to Native AWS (NAWS) with full CI/CD pipelines Participate in definition of coding standards and apply them in code and design reviews Provide estimates for development tasks and negotiate timelines with project leaders Mentor junior team members and help them acquire critical skills and best practices Document and communicate technical concepts to team members and stakeholders Participate in deep technical discussions, where you stand up for your ideas and work with team members to find the best solution for the customer Identify technical and project risks and take initiative to mitigate them A day in the life Full-cycle ownership. You contribute to all aspects of the software development cycle — from scoping and design through implementation, testing, and delivery of features that provide labor performance visibility to Amazon's global fulfillment operations. Billions-scale data processing. You build systems that ingest 19+ billion labor events per year from warehouse floor tools, time clock systems, and employee location heartbeats. You design multi-stage aggregation pipelines that process this data into PPR and PPA reports refreshed every 10–15 minutes, served to 70K+ daily users across 9,800+ facilities. AWS-native architecture. You leverage the full AWS stack — DynamoDB for hot data storage, S3 for historical data, PostgreSQL for aggregated reports, SQS/SNS for event-driven processing, EventBridge and Lambda for serverless job orchestration, and Cosmos/Flink for stream processing. You architect for 99.9% availability across 3 global regions (NA, EU, FE). AI-first development. You pioneer AI-assisted engineering practices — using Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Q, and AI-powered tools to accelerate greenfield development at 20X traditional velocity. You build intelligent systems like AI-powered configuration assistants, automated intake routing, and GenAI-driven operational tooling. Modernization at scale. You modernize a 15+ year-old platform serving every fulfillment center worldwide — consolidating 23+ services into a clean microservices architecture, rebuilding the portal experience in React from legacy JSP/jQuery, and transitioning from batch to stream processing, all while maintaining zero-downtime operations. About The Team About Labor Insights: We build Amazon's global labor management platform — the system of record for measuring associate performance across every fulfillment center, sort center, delivery station, and grocery facility worldwide. Labor Insights tracks how ~1 million associates spend their time, producing the productivity reports (PPR, PPA, attendance, Time Off Task) that operations managers use to make staffing decisions, identify bottlenecks, and ensure customer shipments go out on time. What Makes This Role Exciting Build FCLM 2.0 from the ground up — a once-in-a-career opportunity to greenfield a platform that runs Amazon's global workforce visibility, using AI-first development to deliver in months what would take years through traditional approaches Pioneer stream processing — transition from batch to real-time with sub-minute latencies using Cosmos/Flink, fundamentally changing how Amazon tracks labor performance Build a multi-tenant platform (FCLM FLEX) — design a configurable translation layer that recasts PPR and PPA as flexible views on the same underlying data, eliminating duplicate pipelines and enabling third-party teams to create custom labor views without engineering support Reimagine the portal experience — rebuild the portal used by 70K+ daily users from legacy JSP/jQuery into a modern React application with accessibility, localization, and scalable access controls Expand to new businesses — onboard Amazon Grocery (Fresh, Whole Foods) and other new business lines in 2026+, scaling the platform to new node types and labor models Build AI-powered tools — design intelligent systems using Amazon Bedrock for automated configuration management, request intake, and operational copilots that serve 1.5M workers globally Massive impact — every feature you build is used by tens of thousands of warehouse managers the same day; Labor Insights’ operations save an estimated $25M+ annually Our Tenets Build for Scale: Design generically to support multiple use cases beyond Labor Insights Service Generalization for Multi-Tenancy: Build abstractions that work across all businesses No Data Filtering by Default: Accept all incoming data, build flexible views on top Basic Qualifications 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience Experience programming with at least one software programming language Preferred Qualifications 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. Nexthink is the leader in digital employee experience management software. The company provides IT leaders with unprecedented insight allowing them to see, diagnose and fix issues at scale impacting employees anywhere, with any application or network, before employees notice the issue. As the first solution to allow IT to progress from reactive problem solving to proactive optimization, Nexthink enables its more than 1,500 customers to provide better digital experiences to more than 25+ million employees. Dual headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland and Boston, Massachusetts, Nexthink has 9 offices worldwide. Job Description We are looking for a Senior Desktop Application Developer to be part of the team designing, architecting, and implementing our AI-powered IT self-service chat agent — a native desktop application distributed to 20+ million endpoints worldwide. This client is the face of Nexthink’s AI platform, giving employees a seamless, responsive experience directly on their Windows and macOS devices. As a Desktop Engineer, you will go beyond implementation: you will set technical direction for the client layer, influence cross-team design decisions, and serve as a trusted advisor to both engineering leadership and product. You’ll tackle problems of performance, reliability, and native OS integration while partnering with backend, infra, and security teams to ship a production-grade application at global scale. This is a high-impact, high-ownership role where you’ll make foundational architectural decisions about the client platform and help shape the desktop engineering practice at Nexthink. Responsibilities Define and drive technical vision and architectural strategy for the desktop client application. Lead design of a high-performance, native desktop application running on Windows and macOS at 20M+ endpoints. Partner with product, backend, and AI/ML teams to align the client experience with the broader AI platform. Provide technical leadership on client architecture, coding standards, and best practices for native desktop development. Architect and deliver a reliable, secure application covering the full distribution lifecycle: signing, packaging, installation, updates, and uninstallation. Champion observability, crash reporting, performance monitoring, and diagnostics across the client stack. Act as a mentor and multiplier, raising the technical bar and helping engineers grow. Lead technical deep dives, design reviews, and roadmap alignment discussions with leadership. Ensure security, compliance, and OS-level integration best practices are embedded in design from day one. Qualifications 7+ years of desktop application engineering experience, shipping native applications on Windows and macOS. Proven success designing and shipping client applications to large user bases, with a deep understanding of platform-specific constraints and behaviours. Strong proficiency in C++, with solid experience building cross-platform desktop applications. Deep knowledge of Windows and macOS OS APIs. Hands-on experience with the full application distribution lifecycle: code signing, packaging, auto-update mechanisms, and deployment at scale. Strong understanding of desktop application performance profiling, memory management, and crash diagnostics. Exceptional communication skills — able to influence cross-functional teams and leadership with clear technical direction. Track record of mentoring and elevating engineering teams. Nice to Have Familiarity with Rust and the Tauri framework. Familiarity with React and TypeScript UI development. Experience integrating desktop clients with cloud backends via REST, WebSockets, or gRPC. Background in system-level programming: OS hooks, accessibility APIs, inter-process communication. Prior work on applications with silent background processes, system tray agents, or notification-driven UX. Experience with endpoint telemetry, observability SDKs, or APM integration on the client side. Experience with enterprise software distribution and managing application update strategies at scale. Our innovative solutions integrate real-time analytics, automation, and employee feedback across all endpoints. This enables our IT teams to solve complex technical challenges, create ever more productive workplaces, and deliver happy, satisfied employees in the digital workplace. With over 1200 employees across 5 continents, Nexthink operates as One Team, connecting, collaborating and innovating to continuously grow. We call our employees ‘Nexthinkers’ and our commitment to diversity, inclusion, and equity is second to none. We currently have over 75 nationalities working with us, from all cultures and backgrounds, speaking many different languages. If you are looking for a change and like a nice atmosphere, lots of challenges, and having fun while working, this is a great opportunity for you!
